name: OBSC Perfection Ltd
tagline: Precision-machining SME with a Rs 1,200 Cr order book on ~Rs 190 Cr revenue and a defence/marine mix shift — execution and margin-sustainability unproven
business_overview: OBSC Perfection (IPO 2024, NSE SME) makes precision metal components — historically machined/cast auto parts, now adding a first-ever in-house forging plant (hot + cold) in Pune and diversifying into defence, marine, renewable-energy and (nascent) aerospace parts. Operates from 4-5 fragmented factories in a Gujarat/Chennai tier-2 base, with land acquired to consolidate into an integrated facility.
fundamentals_narrative: Growth and return ratios look strong for an SME, but the market prices ~12x sales, discounting years of flawless execution. The Rs 1,200 Cr order book is ~6x revenue and skews toward higher-margin defence/marine, supporting management's aim to lift the defence/marine mix toward 50% over 3-5 years (auto-component margins are stated at 10-15%, marine/defence pull the blended OPM to ~18%). Rising land/plant additions (Sanand machining unit, ~Rs 49 Cr/yr incremental from Q4 FY27; Maharashtra integrated facility) are the near-term capex.
technical_read: Not pulled — SME liquidity; stock has re-rated hard since IPO.
sentiment_summary: First-time deep read — last ~22 of ~34 posts, Oct 2025 to May 2026. Active, high-quality thread: multiple members did plant visits (Chennai, Pune) and peer analysis vs Sansera/RACL. Bull view: huge book-to-bill, credible defence/marine scale-up, well-connected parent (decades of ties to large auto-component groups), 'fire in the belly' management. Persistent skeptic thread: employee cost as % of sales is implausibly low versus Sansera/RACL — explained (not fully resolved) as heavy job-work/contract-labour outsourcing (809 contract workers Mar-25), which shifts cost to job-work charges and could mean OBSC does mostly finishing/assembly, not the hard machining it claims. Only one concall a year.
community_signal: No trusted-roster users. Non-roster contributors raj1968, Chandragupta, manpritaurora, richbandit, Satishwe carried a substantive, mixed debate (loves 6-26). The X trigger (@LearningEleven, non-roster, stated holder — 'going from scale to scale') is a vetted tip, treated as informational only.
bull_case: ~Rs 1,200 Cr order book on ~Rs 190 Cr revenue, largely nominated (low cancellation risk), with a defence/marine mix shift that is margin-accretive
First in-house forging capacity augments existing machining/casting — a real capability step, with orders already in hand
~18% ROCE, ~25% growth, low debt, integrated-facility consolidation ahead
Parent's long-standing relationships with large auto-component groups underpin order flow
bear_case: Employee cost is anomalously low vs precision-engineering peers — unresolved question over how much true machining is in-house vs outsourced job-work
~12x sales prices near-flawless multi-year execution; post-IPO SMEs frequently see margins fade
Once-a-year concall = thin disclosure; scaling complex machining/forging from a small, fragmented base is hard
Rising debtor days flagged; capex-funding and working-capital needs grow with the order book

commitments.single_point_of_failure: shop-floor machining capacity vs outsourced job-work; working-capital funding

commitments.text: Lift defence/marine to ~50% of revenue to hold/expand blended OPM ~18%
commitments.specifics: auto parts 10-15% OPM; marine/defence pull blended to ~18%
commitments.dependency: qualification wins + mix shift over 3-5 years

commitments.text: Sanand machining unit + Maharashtra integrated facility
commitments.specifics: Sanand ~Rs 49 Cr/yr incremental revenue from Q4 FY27; land acquired for integrated plant

earnings_chain.operating_leverage: unclear - OPM has been flat ~18% while revenue tripled, so leverage is offset by mix/cost; management expects mix to drive future margin, not scale

market_expectation.implied_growth_cagr: ~69x trailing implies ~35-40% EPS CAGR FY26-28 to be fair against a ~25x exit as it graduates from SME; order book + Sanand make FY27-28 plausible, beyond that is a bet on the defence/marine mix
market_expectation.our_fy28_estimate: revenue +30-40% as Sanand + integrated facility contribute; OPM sustainability the swing factor
market_expectation.gap_basis: near-term growth is visible and roughly in the multiple; the market is also paying for the mix-driven margin story and for the job-work question to resolve benign
market_expectation.data_caveat: no broker consensus; implied path is a reverse-P/E estimate + screener.in forward figures + VP thread view

catalyst.event: FY27 annual concall + H2 FY27 prints: Sanand commissioning on schedule, OPM holding ~18%, and disclosure that clarifies in-house machining content vs job-work

value_chain.theme: Precision machined/forged components for auto, defence, marine, renewables
value_chain.position: Tier-2/Tier-1 component supplier; nominated auto business is sticky, defence/marine is the value-add push
value_chain.bottleneck_node: Skilled shop-floor machining capacity and defence/marine qualification (long approval cycles)
value_chain.note: Order book implies the demand-side is secured; the open question is whether OBSC's own capacity/skill (vs outsourced job-work) can execute the machining content at the stated margins.

sources_reviewed: screener.in OBSCP (5yr P&L, ROCE/ROE, borrowings, cash flow, quarterly sequence, shareholding)
Q1FY27 results coverage (tradebrains, trendlyne) - consol rev Rs 78.7 Cr (+84.5% YoY), PAT Rs 9.47 Cr (+87.9% YoY)
FY26 annual results (scanx, goodreturns) - rev Rs 219.5 Cr (+53.8%), PAT Rs 27 Cr (+61.2%)
existing ValuePickr thread (34 posts, plant visits, employee-cost debate)
annual_report_findings: Revenue scaled Rs 56 Cr FY22 -> Rs 220 Cr FY26 (~41% CAGR); FY26 +54% - genuine top-line acceleration
OPM has held ~18% for three straight years (FY24-FY26) through the scale-up - the margin has not faded post-IPO, which was the central bear worry
ROCE ~19.5% and ROE ~20% FY26 (5yr ROE 25%) - strong capital efficiency for the size
Capex ramp is very heavy: FY26 capex Rs 76 Cr vs CFO -Rs 2 Cr => FCF ~ -Rs 79 Cr; FY25 FCF -Rs 24 Cr. Two consecutive years of large negative FCF funding forging + Sanand + integrated facility
Borrowings up Rs 19 Cr (FY22) -> Rs 69 Cr (FY26); D/E still modest (~0.2-0.3x) but rising with the order book and working capital
Promoter holding 69.8%, stable; no disclosed pledge
Employee cost as a % of sales remains structurally below precision-engineering peers (Sansera/RACL) - the thread's outsourced-job-work question is not resolved by the FY26 filing
quarterly_trend: Sales oldest->newest (Rs Cr): 34.8 (Dec24), 40.3 (Mar25), 41.9 (Jun25), 46.8 (Sep25), 59.4 (Dec25), 71.5 (Mar26), 77.3 (Jun26) - steep, steady sequential ramp
Q1FY27 YoY: revenue +84.5%, PAT +87.9% - acceleration, not deceleration
recent_announcements: Order book maintained at Rs 1,200 Cr+ (~5.5x FY26 revenue), mix skewing to defence/marine
~Rs 10.6 Cr export order from a French firm (defence/marine adjacency)
Sanand machining unit - incremental ~Rs 49 Cr/yr revenue from Q4 FY27; Maharashtra integrated facility land acquired
First in-house forging plant (hot + cold), Pune - capability addition with orders in hand
key_new_facts: Margins held ~18% across the entire FY24-FY26 scale-up and into Q1FY27 - the main bear thesis (post-IPO margin fade) has not played out over 2+ years
FCF has been deeply negative two years running (-Rs 24 Cr, -Rs 79 Cr); the growth is real but entirely capex/working-capital-funded
P/E ~69x (screener, Sep-2026); mcap ~Rs 2,180 Cr - still discounting flawless execution
The employee-cost / in-house-machining-vs-job-work question is still open after another full year of filings
open_questions: Is the reported ~18% OPM genuine value-add machining, or is finishing/assembly on outsourced job-work flattering the employee-cost line?
When does FCF inflect - the integrated facility + Sanand capex still ahead, so possibly not before FY28
Can defence/marine qualification cycles actually lift the mix to the stated ~50% in 3-5 years, and hold blended OPM there?
Only one concall a year - disclosure cadence is thin for a name at this multiple
deep_dive.conviction_update: Medium -> Medium. Two more years of held ~18% margins and accelerating growth (Q1FY27 rev +85%) materially answer the margin-fade bear case; but deeply negative FCF, a ~69x multiple, the unresolved job-work question and no trusted-roster engagement (only an informational X tip) keep it from an upgrade.

growth_trajectory.last_quarters_note: Annual revenue YoY: FY23 +70%, FY24 +21%, FY25 +23%, FY26 +54%; recent quarterly YoY running +50-85% (Q1FY27 +84.5%). Order book ~5.5x revenue underpins continued high growth into FY27-28.
growth_trajectory.reverse_pe_note: ~69x trailing needs ~35-40% EPS CAGR FY26-28 at a ~25x SME-graduating exit; the order book and Sanand ramp support that near-term, but the multiple leaves nothing for the job-work/margin question going the wrong way

drivers: defence/marine and export mix (higher value-add than nominated auto)
low reported employee cost (structurally below peers - possibly job-work outsourcing)
operating leverage on a fast-growing revenue base
earnings_quality.normalised_note: OPM ~18% has held for 3 years and into Q1FY27, so it is not an obvious spike above a through-cycle level. The risk is not mean-reversion from a peak but that the margin is partly an artefact of outsourced job-work rather than owned machining - a quality question, not a peak-cycle question.

management_quality.capital_allocation: All reinvestment is in-domain (forging, machining capacity, integrated facility); incremental ROCE has held ~19-20% while scaling 3x, so the reinvestment is earning its keep so far. But FCF is deeply negative and the biggest capex (integrated facility) is still ahead - the discipline claim is unproven through a full cycle.
management_quality.capability_ladder_note: Explicit push up the value curve - machining/casting -> in-house forging -> defence/marine/aerospace components; land acquired to consolidate 4-5 fragmented plants into one integrated facility

track_record.note: FY24-FY26 each had revenue growth >=20% and ROCE ~18-20% (>=15%). FY22-FY23 pre-IPO figures are less reliable and FY23 OPM dipped to 10% with flat PAT, so not counted. The 3-year clean run is real but short, and the low-employee-cost anomaly is an open question over how 'real' the reported returns are.

verdict_headline: Credible high-growth SME story — order book and now three years of held ~18% margins support it, but negative FCF, ~69x P/E and the outsourcing/margin question keep conviction at Medium
verdict_reasoning: Small-cap with strong recent growth and a specific, credible catalyst (a 6x book-to-bill order book weighted to margin-accretive defence/marine) — fits '10x-in-2-3-years' at LOW-MEDIUM conviction with an 'unconfirmed' caveat on margin sustainability.
X signal (@LearningEleven, non-roster, x_conviction 'high') informational only — no conviction floor.

Two unresolved risks — the implausibly low employee cost (outsourced job-work vs genuine in-house machining) and ~12x-sales valuation — cap conviction at Medium pending the next annual concall / FY27 execution.

trusted_signals.note: AS9100D aerospace certification almost in the bag (mgmt guided 6mo ago, customers in discussion); constructive on next concall, notes stock still expensive on valuation.

four_box.note: Defence/marine mix-shift (target 50% of revenue in 3-5yrs) is a real margin-accretive tailwind; Rs1,200cr order book (~5.5x revenue) supports tam; nominated-auto stickiness + defence/marine qualification cycles are a real barrier but unresolved whether in-house machining vs outsourced job-work (employee-cost anomaly) — moat weak; ~69x P/E / ~10x sales already prices near-flawless execution — valuation no. Score 2.5 -> 'neither' by default, but the written exception in verdict_reasoning (live small-cap inflection: Q1FY27 rev +85%, order book ~5.5x, margins held ~18% for 3yrs) keeps 10x-in-2-3-years at Medium with an 'unconfirmed' caveat on margin genuineness.
